what: Drag the stacked photo plates to flip through them. Dragging left covers with the next one from the right using a slanted clip-path (the top leads by 20%) following the hand, and dragging right covers with the previous one from the left, while the photo inside is pushed along at ±60px. On release it finishes the remaining distance in .75s sine.inOut, and a press within 10px flips to the side pressed (right goes to next). The PREV·NEXT tag follows the cursor height inside the plate by .2 per frame. A second row tied by the same data-key (side-column previews) flips together

options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Photo panel (rows split by data-key, default one row)
options.[data-fx-part=img]: Photo inside panel (20px extra on each side)
options.[data-fx-part=count]: (If any) Page numbers such as 2 - 6 — data-key="prev"·"next"

use: …NEXT
note: Dragging is this part’s job, so while dragging sideways on the stage, paging comes first (touch-action: pan-y — pushing vertically scrolls the page). When paging, fx:pick(detail.index)

from.where: works.html photo plate per space (original c-slider: clip-path polygon · .75s sine.inOut · inner ±60px · tag lerp .2 · 10px threshold)
